fields.quote: The development-case, prompt-prior, and eight-task studies use three independent builder runs per condition and report their differences descriptively.
fields.where: Appendix J Limitations, p. 35 (and Table 10 / §G.2, p. 30: 60 extended-budget traces = 10 tasks x 6 held-out cases)
fields.why: The extended-budget study is not one of the three-run studies: the limitations list only the development-case, prompt-prior and eight-task studies as repeated, and Table 10 has 60 traces (one build per task).
fields.doubt: O valor põe o orçamento alargado (1.500 s) sob '3 runs per condition', mas só os estudos de casos de desenvolvimento, priors e Lite têm três execuções (Limitações, pág. 35); o orçamento alargado tem 60 traços = 10 tarefas x 6 casos, ou seja, uma execução por tarefa (pág. 30). Confirma e ajusta.

fields.v: Tasks: the 25 AgentSWE tasks (main), subsets for harness study (2 Creation + 2 Optimization tasks), AgentSWE-Lite (8 tasks), ablations (2 Creation tasks; extended budget all 10). Configurations: builder = harness × model. Baseline: no baseline configuration; in Optimization the starter agent a0 is scored on the same held-out instances. Held constant: task package, budgets, frozen delivery, runtime model per family through a benchmark gateway, judge per family; harness fixed (Codex) in the main comparison, model fixed when varying harness. Acceptance: held-out cases hidden from the builder, validity gates plus rubric scored by an LLM judge (Creation, Editing) or native benchmark evaluator (Optimization). Repetitions: main, harness and extended-budget studies one build per pairing or task; Lite, development-case and prompt-prior studies three independent builds per condition. Human intervention: none during builds
fields.quote: The development-case, prompt-prior, and eight-task studies use three independent builder runs per condition and report their differences descriptively.
fields.where: Appendix J Limitations, p. 35 (and Table 10 / §G.2, p. 30: 60 extended-budget traces = 10 tasks x 6 held-out cases)
fields.why: 'Ablations three independent builds per condition' includes the extended-budget study, which was built once per task.
fields.doubt: Repetições: o estudo de orçamento alargado (10 tarefas de Creation, 1.500 s) foi construído uma vez por tarefa, não três. Só os estudos de casos de desenvolvimento, priors e AgentSWE-Lite têm três execuções (pág. 35). Corrige o número de repetições.
